name: scene-prahar
title: Prahar
description: A day over a Goan river village in the eight watches of raga time: the sky blended in OKLab, every land layer tinted to the light, the sun and moon on their arcs, lamps after dusk, and a ruler of the eight prahars with each raga in English and Devanagari. Set hour from the page's own clock for a theme that follows the viewer's day; in playful, drag the ruler. The raga-to-hour mapping is one common reckoning; traditions differ.
